Body.Content: Administration delegation in Azure Active Directory through administrative units is available in public preview. These logical containers can include users and groups, plus allow member password and user access administration to be delegated to individual users. Administrative units can be created and managed only via Windows PowerShell during this public preview. For more information, please visit Manage Azure AD using Windows PowerShell.
Body.Markdown:
Administration delegation in Azure Active Directory through administrative units is available in public preview. These logical containers can include users and groups, plus allow member password and user access administration to be delegated to individual users. Administrative units can be created and managed only via Windows PowerShell during this public preview.

For more information, please visit Manage Azure AD using Windows PowerShell .
